actions.name: event_create
actions.description: Create a calendar event/appointment: title and start_ms are required; optional description, end_ms (>= start_ms), all_day flag, remind_before_ms (fires a reminder that many ms before start, 0 = at start), up to 32 tags, and an RRULE for recurrence. Returns the assigned id and full event.

end_ms.description: End time, unix milliseconds. Optional; must be >= start_ms.

all_day.description: Metadata flag for date-only events; clients interpret display.

remind_before_ms.description: Fire a reminder this many ms before start_ms (0 = exactly at start). Absent = no reminder.

tags.description: Tags: trimmed, empties dropped, deduplicated, each ≤64 bytes. Optional.

actions.name: event_get
actions.description: Fetch one calendar event by its exact id. Returns found=false (not an error) if no such event exists. Note: recurring-event occurrences returned by event_list carry synthetic ids (masterId#timestamp) that this action can't look up — fetch the master id instead. Use event_list to search/browse.

actions.name: event_list
actions.description: List/browse calendar events sorted by start time ascending, optionally windowed by from_ms/to_ms and filtered by tag; limit (default 100, max 500) and offset (default 0) paginate. Recurring events (rrule set) are expanded into concrete occurrences within the window (default window when from_ms/to_ms omitted: now-1d..now+90d), each with a synthetic id. Use event_get when you already know the id.

from_ms.description: Only events with start_ms >= this. Optional.

to_ms.description: Only events with start_ms <= this. Optional.

tag.description: Only events carrying this tag. Optional.

offset.description: Skip this many events after filtering/sorting.

events.description: Sorted by start_ms ascending (id ascending tie-break).

actions.name: event_update
actions.description: Edit an existing calendar event by id: title, description, start_ms, end_ms, all_day, remind_before_ms, tags, and/or rrule each replace the prior value only when present (rrule: null clears recurrence; tags replaces the whole set). Changing start_ms/end_ms/remind_before_ms/rrule resets a previously-fired reminder so it can fire again. Errors if the event doesn't exist or the resulting end_ms < start_ms.

start_ms.description: Replaces the start when present; resets reminder_fired.

end_ms.description: Replaces the end when present; resets reminder_fired. Must be >= resulting start_ms.

remind_before_ms.description: Replaces the reminder lead when present; resets reminder_fired.

tags.description: Replaces the whole tag set when present.

rrule.description: RRULE string or null to clear. Optional.

actions.name: event_delete
actions.description: Permanently delete a calendar event by id (and, for a recurring event, all its occurrences) — no undo, cancels any pending reminder. Returns deleted=false (not an error) if the event didn't exist, so it's safe to call idempotently.

deleted.description: True only when the event existed and was removed.

actions.name: calendar_ics_import
actions.description: Bulk-import events from a base64-encoded VCALENDAR/.ics payload (max ~6 MiB decoded): VEVENTs within [now-1d, now+90d] are created, or updated in place by UID if a matching import already exists, so re-importing the same calendar is safe. RRULEs (DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY with INTERVAL/COUNT/UNTIL/BYDAY) expand into concrete stored occurrences, capped at MAX_IMPORT_DOCS total documents (errors past the cap — narrow the calendar or window). Returns counts of imported/updated/parsed events and their ids.

ics_base64.description: Base64-encoded VCALENDAR payload (max ~6 MiB decoded). VEVENTs within [now-1d, now+90d] are upserted keyed by UID — re-importing the same calendar updates in place. RRULEs expand to concrete occurrences (DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY with INTERVAL/COUNT/UNTIL/BYDAY).

actions.name: calendar_ics_export
actions.description: Export every stored calendar event (sorted by start time) as a single base64-encoded VCALENDAR/.ics payload, for backup or import into another calendar app. No parameters.

ics_base64.description: Base64-encoded VCALENDAR with every stored event (sorted by start_ms).

end_ms.description: Unix time in milliseconds; null when unset.

remind_before_ms.description: Reminder lead in ms; null = no reminder.

reminder_fired.description: True once the reminder was fired (reset when times change).

ics_uid.description: UID from an ICS import; re-imports upsert by it. null for hand-created events.

rrule.description: RRULE string; null when not recurring.

CALENDAR_PLUGIN_DB_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout for each database IPC call.

CALENDAR_PLUGIN_SCAN_SECS.description: Reminder scan interval in seconds; 0 disables scanning entirely.

CALENDAR_PLUGIN_NOTIFY.description: Also deliver fired reminders through the notify plugin (best-effort).
